articles.title: 8 Near-Perfect Anime To Watch if You Like 'Solo Leveling'
articles.summary: In Solo Leveling, gifted Hunters fight vicious beasts to protect humanity, but the notoriously weak Sung Jin-woo finds himself trapped in a hopeless survival loop. Whereas the power levels of all Hunters are fixed, Jin-woo is chosen by the enigmatic "System" and is given the ability to accrue…
body: Some anime stories rely on exaggerated power fantasies to prop up a stand-out protagonist, but Solo Leveling takes it to another level. This trope can take many forms when used for sustained dramatic effect in genres like shonen or isekai. Shows like One-Punch Man come alive thanks to satirical deadpan humor while still delivering on the power fantasy. Others, like The Eminence in Shadow, embrace a ludicrous brand of self-aware absurdity. By contrast, Solo Leveling, which is based on a fantasy web novel by Chugong (later adapted into an immensely popular manhwa), uses addictive dungeon-crawler elements and RPG-style power progression to keep things dynamic and interesting.

Based on the Korean web novel and manhwa by Sanji Jiksong, Tomb Raider King might be the closest spiritual successor to Solo Leveling on this list. Mysterious tombs have appeared around the world, each containing powerful relics drawn from mythology and history. Ruthless corporations quickly turn their recovery into a lucrative industry, employing raiders like Seo Joo-Heon to brave the tombs on their behalf.
points: In Solo Leveling, gifted Hunters fight vicious beasts to protect humanity, but the notoriously weak Sung Jin-woo finds himself trapped in a hopeless survival loop.

articles.title: DreamWorks’ 'Kpop Demon Hunters' Replacement Officially Arrives in 1 Week
articles.summary: Netflix’s animated musical Kpop Demon Hunters was an unexpected sensation, spending a full year in the streaming service’s global top 10 list. The film about a K-pop band whose music secretly empowers a mystical barrier protecting the world from demons racked up more than 500 million views…
body: A sequel is in the works, but it will likely be years until its release given how long animation takes to produce. Netflix is also working on launching a global concert tour. But a new treat for Kpop Demon Hunters fans is arriving in three weeks. Forgotten Island, an original DreamWorks Animation film from Puss in Boots: The Last Wish co-directors Joel Crawford and Januel Mercado, combines demons, music, and a sweet story about female friendship for a fantasy film that is likely to resonate with anyone obsessed with Huntrix and the Saja Boys.

Set in the Philippines in the 1990s, Forgotten Island follows best friends Jo (H.E.R.) and Raissa (Liza Soberano). When Raissa is admitted to Caltech, Jo insists they spend one last memorable night together. While they just plan on goofing off on the beach, they wind up finding a portal to Nakali, a mystical realm from the stories told by Jo’s grandmother.

articles.title: Original Gran Turismo Circuit Returns to Series After 13-Year Absence
articles.summary: Polyphony Digital has revealed Gran Turismo 7’s next major update will mark the return of Autumn Ring, and includes a dozen new cars, the series debut of real-life circuit Sportsland Sugo, and a variety of other features.
body: The ‘Spec IV’ update will be delivered in two parts before the end of 2026; the first will arrive in October and the second will be available in December.

The first chunk of Spec IV will come with Sportland Sugo (a real-life race circuit located in Japan’s Miyagi Prefecture that currently hosts Super GT and Super Formula rounds) plus six new cars, a new ‘Vintage’ section featuring cars not available to purchase in GT as new, a ‘Car Concierge’ function players can use to order used and Legend cars, new driving challenges, a new car viewer, and a Collector Level cap increase.

The second half of Spec IV will include Autumn Ring, another six new cars, a new ‘Family’ mode for inexperienced players, a luck-based race with random cars called ‘Shuffle Race’, online drift trials, and a new difficulty level in the Power Pack.
Autumn Ring, first seen in the original Gran Turismo, was last included in 2013’s Gran Turismo 6. The GT7 version of Autumn Ring will include the original layout, and a new “greatly expanded layout.”

articles.title: Marvel’s Most Valuable Figure Right Now Is Based on a Bizarre 1977 Spider-Man Show
articles.summary: Spider-Man continues to prove that he's the most popular superhero on the planet. With Spider-Man: Brand New Day continuing to break box office records and Amazing Spider-Man #1000 marking a major milestone in comics history, it looks like the sky's the limit for the web-slinger.
body: ActionFigure411 recently released its list of the 20 most valuable action figures based on Marvel Comics, and topping that list is a Hot Toys figure of Spider-Man. Specifically, it's the version of Spider-Man depicted in a short-lived 1977 television series featuring the wall-crawling hero. While the 1977 Spider-Man figure has a retail price of $255, it has sold for as much as $768.50. That's solid proof that Spider-Man is a major draw, no matter the version. But it also brings back memories of what might be the weirdest Spider-Man series ever.

"The whole appeal of the character is the contrast and conflict between his private life as Peter Parker and his life as Spider-Man...The comic book version is more adult and sophisticated than the TV version."

articles.title: Save $3,000 Off the Massive 83" LG Evo M3 4K OLED TV With Wireless Connectivity and 5 Year Warranty
articles.summary: LG OLED TVs are generally divided into three tiers: the highest-end G (Gallery) series, the mid-range C-series, and the budget-friendly B-series. Lesser known amongst LG's OLED lineup is the M-series.
body: For a limited time, Electronic Express via eBay is offering a brand new 83" LG Evo M3 4K OLED Smart TV for $2,499 with free shipping after 20% off coupon code " LABORDAY20 ". Compare that to the MSRP of $5,500 when it was first released in August of 2023. Since the M3 is considered a "premium" LG TV - on par with LG's Gallery series TVs - you get a 5-year panel warranty.

What sets the M3 apart from LG's other OLED TVs is its wireless connectivity. You still have to deal with the power cable, but the rest of the connections go to a "Zero Connect" wireless box that can sit 30 feet away from the TV itself and still stream in 4K at up to 120Hz. That allows for a cleaner setup since you now only need to route a single cable.

The LG Evo M3 uses the same panel as the Gallery Series G3. Despite being nearly three years old, this panel is better than the recent generation LG Evo C5. That's because it uses Micro Lens Array (MLA) technology for its OLED panel, which dramatically increases brightness levels. The Evo C5 is not equipped with this technology. Granted the M3 doesn't have the Tandem OLED tech you'll find on the new G5 TV, but a 83" G5 model currently costs $5,000.

articles.title: Netflix Is Officially Streaming the Most Satisfying Action Thriller of the Decade
articles.summary: Coined in 2009 by TV producer and comic book writer John Rogers, "competence porn" is a sort of informal subgenre of entertainment that's built around watching characters who are genuinely quite good at their jobs.
body: Ready or Not 2: Here I Come, which is now available for streaming on Hulu, is the precise opposite of that.

This is a movie about a squadron of people who are forced to work outside their core competencies, because they do not have any. That doesn't mean they aren't dangerous, but it's often not in the way that they'd like to be. In the age of the Business Idiot, there's a sick thrill to watching the sons and daughters of privilege instantly crash and burn, and that thrill is most of what drives Ready or Not 2.
As it's a direct sequel, it's difficult to discuss Ready or Not 2 without disclosing parts of 2019's Ready or Not. Some spoilers follow.

In the original Ready or Not, Grace (Samara Weaving) discovers on her wedding night that her new husband's family owe their wealth and privilege to a demonic pact. As part of that pact, Grace is set loose on the family estate and hunted down as a human sacrifice. Grace survives. Her former in-laws don't.

articles.title: GTA 6 Is Completely Changing How You Steal Cars
articles.summary: Carjacking in Grand Theft Auto games has been, as the title denotes, a staple of the series. Up until now, it's largely been the same. While there have been more details and animations added over the years, the premise has remained that you'll walk up to a car, press Y or Triangle, throw the driver…
body: There are two ways to steal a car: taking one that's stationary, or taking one that someone's driving around in. However, there are more details that make GTA 6 feel more like true simulation gameplay now.

As we saw in the GTA 6 extended look gameplay, when Jason approached a car, he had multiple options to choose from. The first option is a slim jim--a classic tool used to break into older vehicles. It slides down the window frame to adjust the lock, and in GTA 6, it seems like this is done via a lockpicking minigame. However, based on what we've heard so far, that won't work for every car. Depending on the year and model of the vehicle, you might not be able to use a slim jim.

However, newer and more expensive cars might not work with this method. On top of that, there are trackers, meaning that the police can track your location when you steal a car. This changes the whole carjacking aspect of Grand Theft Auto. Normally, if you'd steal a car, you might catch some heat; maybe a nearby police officer sees you and follows you, but it's pretty easy to get away cleanly. This time, that isn't the case.

articles.title: The Last of Us Season 3 Did Not Include Naughty Dog’s Involvement For Creative Choices
articles.summary: Writer-director Neil Druckmann dropped out of HBO's The Last of Us TV show to focus on Naughty Dog's gaming output, including Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet. In a new interview, he said Season 3--which, again, he had no direct involvement in, will "wrap up" the series.
body: Druckmann said this to The Washington Post, confirming, "I wasn't involved in shaping this season's creative direction," nor was Naughty Dog involved. "So I can't personally speak to how production is progressing," he said.

The Last of Us ending after Season 3 would be no surprise, as HBO management said that would likely happen. Druckmann was very closely involved in Seasons 1 and 2; he co-wrote some of the episodes and directed two.
Druckmann went on to say that Naughty Dog remains "the steward of this IP" and even though the HBO show might be coming to an end, he teased, "We're not done with The Last of Us."
He went on to say, "There's a couple projects in the works that, when the time is right, I'm very excited to talk about."

articles.title: It's really starting to look like a new StarCraft game will be revealed at BlizzCon
articles.summary: I don't want to get anybody's hopes up, but with BlizzCon 2026 now just over a week away, it really is starting to look like something—possibly something big —is happening in the world of StarCraft.
body: The excitement began earlier this week when Korea's Chosun ( Google translated, via WCCFTech ) ran a story saying Nexon is close to finalizing a deal to develop a new game based on the StarCraft series. As Chosun noted, the series has been dormant since StarCraft Remastered in 2017; the last original StarCraft game, StarCraft 2, arrived all the way back in 2010. Despite that, the series remains hugely popular in Korea.

The StarCraft subreddit took some issues with the report: For one thing, Chosun suggested the new game would be StarCraft 3, rather than the StarCraft shooter Nexon is reportedly working on. There are also concerns that the report might be accurate, given CEO Junghun Lee's enthusiasm for generative AI and microtransactions. Still, the timing seemed right: BlizzCon 2026 runs September 12-13, which is now less than two weeks away.

That's how things remained until earlier today, when the StarCraft website started glitching, in the way that doesn't happen unless it's intentional: Images twitching, text flashing, all that sort of thing. The classic loss of signal right before something happens—that's probably not a coincidence, right?
points: I don't want to get anybody's hopes up, but with BlizzCon 2026 now just over a week away, it really is starting to look like something—possibly something big —is happening in the world of StarCraft.

Various visual elements on the official StarCraft website are now glitching out in a way that looks much more "hey fans, get excited" than "alert the engineering team that we've got a…
body: The glitches were flagged on Bluesky by John Carson, and they specifically appear on the section of Blizzard's website advertising 2017's StarCraft Remastered, rather than StarCraft II. The glitches see certain images and text become briefly distorted, though to my eye, there is nothing specific to glean from them.

But this sudden marketing stunt feels noteworthy given that the StarCraft franchise has largely been dormant for years. 2026 has brought rumors that something is afoot: The publisher behind Arc Raiders was said to be working on a StarCraft shooter that would be revealed at BlizzCon. More recently, a report from The Chosun Daily claimed that Nexon was seeking the rights to develop a new RTS, possibly StarCraft III.

articles.title: Dungeons And Dragons Icons Could Take The TTRPG To A Modern-Day Setting
articles.summary: The D&D Icons initiative, led by actor and longtime D&D fanatic Joe Manganiello, brings today's Dungeons & Dragons game together with famous series creators of the past, like author R.A. Salvatore's The Legend of Drizzt.
body: Speaking to GameSpot's Jessica Cogswell at Gen Con 2026, Manganiello stressed that modern-day settings could be part of the Icons program, too.

"There [are] also lots of other things that I want for Icons in the future," he said. "I think that there's a great present-day game that pushes genetics and military. We're moving at such a rapid pace, but I think there could be a game that takes place in our modern world. There are also some other worlds of D&D that I think could be revisited in new and exciting ways that weren't maximized their first time around."

Manganiello, whose official title is chief creative officer, is keeping specifics secret for now, but it sounds like, for fans of more modern fantasy adventures, D&D Icons could be for you. Could something futuristic like Halo or Horizon: Zero Dawn make sense for the D&D ruleset? Only time will tell, but it could open up the D&D experience to an even wider audience. Wizards has experimented with more modern content in the past, so it's not unprecedented.

articles.title: I've found DLSS 5 can slash frame rates by up to 73% on an RTX 5080 gaming PC in NBA 2K27, and I'm wondering what kind of mega-rig would justify the performance hit
articles.summary: At what cost AI-enhanced graphics? Frames, it seems.
body: Given the RTX 5080 is Nvidia's second-fastest consumer graphics card, I had no qualms about turning up the settings to Ultra, including enabling ray tracing. I recorded my results during actual gameplay within NBA 2K27's quick match mode, making sure to play for long enough that cutaway shots to the player's celebrations and the crowd triggered several times.

It's worth mentioning, however, that given the lack of repeatability within this mode, these results are potentially more representative of the DLSS 5 average frame rate hit, rather than game performance overall.
Results recorded during gameplay in NBA 2K27 at Ultra settings, ray tracing enabled, using an RTX 5080.

And my goodness, what a performance hit it is. The difference between the Native 1440p average frame rate and the average rate with DLSS enabled is a whole 137 frames. A 93 fps average still results in very smooth gameplay overall, but the drop to just 37 fps in terms of 1% lows is very troubling.

articles.title: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation finally gets a 2027 release date, as Final Fantasy Resonance gets a surprise demo
articles.summary: We already knew that Final Fantasy 7 Revelation was going to launch sometime in 'spring 2027 ', but today director Naoki Hamaguchi took to Sony's State of Play livestream to inform us all that the game has a locked-in release date: 8th April, 2027.
body: In case you're unaware, the game is the final part of a trilogy that began with Final Fantasy 7 Remake and tells the story of the original FF7 in three parts. This closing chapter sees Cloud finally catch up to Sephiroth as the heroic gang tries to prevent the almighty meteor from colliding with the planet. To make matters worse, the existential threat to all life on the continent has also awoken planetary defense mechanisms known as Weapons which, in defending the planet at all costs, may also pose a risk to humanity. D'oh.

The State of Play trailer showed off new gameplay footage, showing us how Cid's airship - the Highwind - can be used to travel to the regions of the world. This will be the biggest game in the trilogy, by far, including all the locations we've seen in the other games, plus some new original areas, too. It's very much 'the final disc' of the original FF7, if you ask me, and has been scaled appropriately. I recently had a big chat with Hamaguchi, and was taken aback by his humbleness and vision for the trilogy. If you're excited about what the game has to offer, I encourage you to give the feature a read.

videos.title: Crimson Desert - Charting the Unknown DLC Reveal Trailer
videos.summary: (This gameplay trailer contains actual in-game footage captured on PlayStation 5 Pro. As a work-in-progress, the content is subject to change.)
body: Reclaim power and reach beyond—into the unknown.

The story of Pywel continues in Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown as Kliff, Oongka, and Damiane set out to discover their purpose and shape their futures. However, as turmoil unfolds around them, each must fight to forge a path through the trials ahead. Join them on a new adventure and discover what new possibilities await across Pywel.

videos.title: GTA 6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers Revealed - IGN Daily Fix
videos.summary: Rockstar Games and Sony have revealed a pair of limited edition PS5 DualSense controllers with a GTA 6 theme. One is black, the other white, and have the GTA 6 logo and other designs etched into the controllers. Both will be sold separately for about $85.
points: Rockstar Games and Sony have revealed a pair of limited edition PS5 DualSense controllers with a GTA 6 theme.
One is black, the other white, and have the GTA 6 logo and other designs etched into the controllers.
Pre-orders will open via PlayStation Direct on September 10th.
Final Fantasy 7 Revelations will drop on April 8, 2027 on Xbox Series X|S, PS5, and Nintendo Switch 2.
